description: Pixel age from Present() submission to a (1, 3, 640, 640) FP16 tensor on CUDA, per capture path. Medians across passes of 8 s per path; min/max are the per-pass extremes. Every path verified before timing. Status 'contaminated' means the path read as fast as the source presented, so its fps is a floor.
machine: Machine B, MUX hybrid: Intel UHD capture, RTX 4060 Laptop CUDA, 2560x1600 at 165 Hz
